contexts.text: When man is described in the Word, he is described distinctly, as to the one part, and as to the other... Thus there is a full description of everything.
These things can hardly be described to the common apprehension...
By description from such things they are more obscured.
If they were described, even most clearly, they would still appear obscure. AC 4302:2.
That all things cannot be described. Signified.
This does not enter the sense, however it is described.
Few of these things can be described...
The singular truths, which are the interiors of faith, can never be described...
Heavenly joy itself, such as it is in its essence, cannot be described...
Because from living experience, I can know it, but never describe it.
Hence it is that the Spiritual World cannot be described... SE 1086.
There are very few things there which are described.

These distinctions cannot be expressed in natural language, thus not described... They can only be expressed and described by the Angels themselves, by means of their own languages, words, and writings.
Jehovah shall count in describing the peoples ().
How the spiritual operate cannot be described before the Natural; and how the celestial operate cannot be described before the Spiritual.
Nor can these things be described, except imperfectly...
